name: Takara Hanabusa
source:
Takara is a boisterous Olympic-qualifying track runner, made even more impressive by her genetically predisposed body type. She was raised as a Miko of her village's shrine, and was often teased for her size during ceremonial marathons. After many months of training, fueled by prayer and willpower, Takara was able to not only outrun her bullies but also take the record for their age-old tradition. Once she started running, she never faltered, never stopped, and never looked back.

[From [url=https://www.mangofactory.win/kumitantei/characters]official site[/url]]
